constraint.equation: σ_bone = F / A ≤ σ_yield (rigid body assumption valid when σ_bone << σ_yield)

validityBoundaries.validWhen: Bone stress << yield stress; strain rate < 0.01/s; no fracture or plastic deformation
validityBoundaries.violatedWhen: Impact loading (strain rate > 1/s), stress approaching yield (~130 MPa cortical), pathological bone (osteoporosis)
validityBoundaries.consequence: Rigid body dynamics underestimates deformation and energy absorption; joint forces may be overestimated
validityBoundaries.reference: Reilly & Burstein, J Bone Joint Surg Am 56(5):1001–1022, 1974
